name: caol.patrol_sound_focused_mcw
description: Do assigned camp defenders investigate actual audible events without inventing threats? Use an assigned, equipped patrol and a real reachable sound source. Compare quiet routine with the selected audible event and follow the same defender through response and return.

steps.label: observe_patrol_sound_duty
steps.objective: Do assigned camp defenders investigate actual audible events without inventing threats? Use an assigned, equipped patrol and a real reachable sound source. Compare quiet routine with the selected audible event and follow the same defender through response and return. Success boundary: The actual sound produces an appropriate bounded investigation; quiet routine is preserved and the defender resumes useful service.
proof_targets: same actor and personal rule before duty for OFF and ON starts
native priority assignment and actual loop and hold runtime ownership
native effective rule UI while duty is active with personal preference preserved
qualified audible event outside the guard sight and observed NPC response, with actual danger and reachability conditions
native duty release and revealed personal rule for each starting value
native save/quit and reload of same actor and duty state
invariants: fixture Patrol zone and practical scene preparation have zero gameplay credit
only native actions and independent observations establish NPC perception, movement, rule state and elapsed time
danger, sound priority, visibility, reachability and zone filters remain operative; ON does not guarantee investigation
do not modify NPC state or saves, fabricate sound perception or action, inject receipts, or credit bootstrap
preserve both starting values and distinguish loop from hold and each duty exit
keep actual failures and limitations distinct from qualification and claim acceptance

steps.label: observe_patrol_sound_after_reload
steps.objective: Observe the same actor after native save and process replacement; verify the effective duty setting and personal preference, then complete any remaining native sound, duty-exit and restoration observations.
proof_targets: same actor and actual patrol runtime after reload
effective rule during duty and personal rule after native duty exit
qualified sound and observed response where still required
invariants: do not reinstall the fixture or directly edit NPCs or saves
preserve actual duty, sound and release observations without inventing prior stages

catalogue.family_purpose: Observe real assignments, patrols and persistent camp service.

playtest_recipe.title: Patrol reacts to sound
playtest_recipe.question: Do assigned camp defenders investigate actual audible events without inventing threats?

starting_state.guidance: Use the declared coherent footing for this executable route. The standard house is the default adaptation for fire, camp and human interaction questions; it is not a substitute for a specific retained state or controlled diagnostic. Preserve owner originals.

playtest_recipe.exercise: Use an assigned, equipped patrol and a real reachable sound source. Compare quiet routine with the selected audible event and follow the same defender through response and return.
controls: play look — identify the current input owner and relevant scene.
play controls — obtain current native actions and copyable movement/wait requests.
play act ACTION [--target STABLE_ID] — select an advertised action; use live IDs, not historical examples.
play wait 5m safe — example of a batched native wait, not a required interval. Choose duration and safe/stop/ignore for the actual question; ignore can allow injury or death.
For movement, use the advertised game.move_relative request through play call --request REQUEST.json, or native overmap travel for a usable route. Stop at a decision, obstruction or danger.
play collect — collect an outstanding request instead of submitting it again.
play inspect SELECTOR — retrieve the relevant field from the returned evidence handle.
playtest_recipe.batching: Batch to the next useful observation or decision, not to a prescribed command count. Read menu replies before choosing targets. Preserve pending request IDs; inspect partial progress and continue the same request when appropriate. Read-only observations do not advance game time.
playtest_recipe.success: The actual sound produces an appropriate bounded investigation; quiet routine is preserved and the defender resumes useful service.
playtest_recipe.failure: A reproducible contradiction under the stated opportunity is a finding. Preserve the first divergence and distinguish product behavior from setup, transport or stale-input faults. Do not force the expected outcome.
playtest_recipe.inconclusive: Missing source, observer, reachability, elapsed time or current input ownership leaves that part unproved. Repair incidental setup in the current run where possible; do not substitute an easier endpoint.
playtest_recipe.evidence: Use play controls evidence_logs and the actual returned selectors. Record selected source/build, run and actor/site IDs, game-time endpoints and the decisive native events. Correlate emission, receipt, decision and physical action when relevant; a log label or spoken success alone is insufficient.
playtest_recipe.finish: Save useful unfinished state through the native save action. When the run is settled, close its game/helpers, verify exit and delete generated saves/logs/captures and temporary declarations. Keep owner originals and concise current findings; no archive.
playtest_recipe.reuse: Update this recipe with proven setup, controls and diagnostic queries that change future decisions. Replace obsolete advice. Keep live IDs and one-run chronology out; prior success is scoped evidence, not a current-build guarantee.
